headword: {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}
gloss: status report; progress report; current situation report

definitions.gloss: status report; progress report; current situation report
definitions.explanation: a report describing the present state of affairs, often used in business and project management

examples.japanese: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧、{現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give a status report once a week.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled a status report on the project into a document.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{進捗|しんちょく}→進捗：07377_shinchoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{思|おも}わしく⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧しにくかった。
examples.english: The department manager asked for a status report, but progress was poor and it was hard to report.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧ (current situation; status quo) + ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (report). A staple of Japanese business communication, especially in meetings, emails, and project updates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a status report
- {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to request a status report
- {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a status report
- {現状報告|げんじょうほうこく}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: written status report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{進捗報告|しんちょくほうこく}→進捗報告：26881_shinchokuhoukoku⟧: progress report — focuses specifically on how much progress has been made toward a goal
- ⟦{中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}→中間報告：16653_chuukanhoukoku⟧: interim report — a report given partway through a project or process
- ⟦{経過報告|けいかほうこく}→経過報告：22899_keikahoukoku⟧: progress update — emphasizes the process and developments over time
